entities.summary: Swoiia (b. 1994-07-04, Donetsk) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Donetsk and Ukraine. Known in the fields of ukraine, composers & musicians, europe.
